pricing.title: Choose the Right Learning Plan
pricing.subtitle: Automated 24/7 PayOS VietQR activation with instant access to AI grading and SRS memory tools.
pricing.freePlanDesc: Get started with contextual vocabulary acquisition.
pricing.teacherBenefitDesc: When educators subscribe to a Teacher Plan, all students in your classes get premium features unlocked completely free up to the plan limit!
pricing.faq1Q: How does VietQR PayOS payment work?
pricing.faq1A: You select a plan, scan the dynamic VietQR code with any Vietnamese banking app, and your plan activates automatically within seconds.
pricing.faq2Q: What happens when a teacher upgrades?
pricing.faq2A: When a teacher purchases Pro/Ultra Teacher plans, all linked students in their classrooms automatically receive full Pro essay grading access.
pricing.faq3Q: Can I cancel or change plans anytime?
pricing.faq3A: Yes, your active subscription remains valid until the end of the billing period without any hidden fees.
